title: Input Recovery from Configuration Encodings
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,s,C\in\mathbb N$ with $C\ge |Q|+6k+5$, where $Q$ is its state set. If $x$ and $y$ are Boolean inputs of length $n$, and configurations $c$ on $x$ and $d$ on $y$ have equal configuration encodings, then $x=y$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
n, s, and C are natural numbers
C is at least the number of states of M plus 6k+5
x and y are Boolean inputs each of length n
c is a configuration on x
d is a configuration on y
the configuration encodings of c and d are equal
